say:1:1730158801:1.text: *Cough* From what I've gathered, Peggy only drew the sword because her mother told her to!
say:1:1730158801:1.source_cn: 咳咳，我听说佩吉自己并不想拔剑，这一切的背后全都是因为王后！

say:2:1730158802:1.text: As we all know, the Queen and Prince Orion have always been at odds. That's why she hopes Peggy can draw the sword and inherit the throne.
say:2:1730158802:1.source_cn: 王后不是一直和奥利安王子不和吗？所以就希望佩吉能拔出石...
